item.title: [Studio Canal UK] THE MAN WHO FELL TO EARTH | Theatrical Trailer | In Cinemas 13 November 2026 | Starring David Bowie
item.description:
Experience the visionary sci-fi classic THE MAN WHO FELL TO EARTH like never before. This 50th Anniversary theatrical trailer offers a glimpse into the haunting journey of an alien stranded on Earth, starring the legendary David Bowie. Directed by Nicolas Roeg, this film remains a timeless exploration of isolation and humanity.

The Man Who Fell to Earth returns to cinemas on 13th November 2026 for a limited theatrical release. Don’t miss your chance to witness this cult classic on the big screen.

item.title: [Studio Canal UK] PAN'S LABYRINTH (20th Anniversary) Trailer | In Cinemas 30 October 2026 | STUDIOCANAL
item.description:
In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious labyrinth, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.
